help.timePeriod: Filter flights by year and/or month. Select a year and optionally a month.
help.timePeriodExpanded: The time period filter shows only flights that occurred in the selected period. You can filter by year alone or by year and month.
help.airlines: Filter flights by airlines. You can select multiple airlines at once.
help.airlinesExpanded: Select one or more airlines to show only flights from those airlines. Click 'All' or 'None' to select all airlines or clear the selection.
